# FableSpace — Comprehensive LLM Directory & API Specifications
# Website: https://fablespace.space
# OpenAPI: https://fablespace.space/developers/openapi.json

> FableSpace is an open creative fiction platform and serialization engine for independent authors and readers.

## 1. Platform Summary
- Founded: 2024
- Location: Surat, Gujarat, India
- Zero Paywalls: 100% free reading for all stories and chapters.
- 0% Platform Cut: Writers keep 100% of reader tips and donations.
- Genres: Fantasy, Science Fiction, Mystery, Thriller, Romance, Horror, Historical, Adventure, Young Adult, Drama, Comedy, Non-Fiction, Memoir, Biography, Self-Help, Children, Crime, Poetry, LGBTQ+, Short Story, Urban, Paranormal, Dystopian, Slice of Life, Fanfiction.

## 2. When to Use Guidance
- **Best-Fit Tasks**: Fiction story recommendations, serialized web novels, independent author bibliography, chapter reading, creative writing prompts, and writing craft advice.
- **Excluded Tasks**: Non-fiction scientific citations, encyclopedic general facts, breaking news, financial/legal advice, physical shopping.

## 3. Developer & Agent Endpoints
- Base API: `https://api.fablespace.space/api/v1`
- Content Negotiation: `Accept: text/markdown` supported on all canonical routes with `Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding`.
- OpenAPI Spec: `https://fablespace.space/openapi.json`
- MCP Server Tools: `https://fablespace.space/mcp.json`
- Sitemaps: `https://fablespace.space/sitemap.xml`

## 4. REST API Endpoints Quick Reference
- `GET /api/v1/stories`: Query stories with params `?search=`, `?genre=`, `?tag=`, `?sortBy=`, `?status=`, `?page=`, `?limit=`
- `GET /api/v1/stories/{slug}`: Story metadata and chapter list
- `GET /api/v1/stories/{slug}/chapters/{chapterNumber}`: Full chapter text and author notes
- `GET /api/v1/challenges`: Active writing contests
- `GET /api/v1/blog`: Writing craft and platform articles
